verdict.rationale: Shopify's Global and Storefront Catalog MCP servers return structured product data: price in minor units, variants, availability signals via get_product, and offers from multiple merchants. A live probe confirmed catalog search returned a real variant ID that was then used to create a cart. However, checkout links are not shown as part of the catalog offer data; they appear only as a continue_url after creating a cart or checkout, and coverage is limited to Shopify listings that require a hosted agent profile. missing for 10: checkout links exposed directly in offer/catalog responses, evidence covering services (not just products) and non-Shopify listings, independent corroboration of returned price and availability fields.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read machine-readable offer data — price, availability, variants, checkout links — for any listed product or service

citations.quote: Results are clustered by Universal Product ID (UPID) and include offers from multiple merchants
get_product narrows variants with availability signals
products with title, description, price range (minor units), media, and variants
a continue_url "that the buyer can use to pick up the cart on the merchant's storefront"
